    Who will win WBC in 2026?

    AI Overview
    The United States is heavily favored to win the 2026 World Baseball Classic (WBC) final against Venezuela, with sportsbooks and analysts pointing to the USA's stacked roster, elite pitching (Skenes, Skubal, Miller), and deep lineup (Judge, Witt Jr., Harper) as key advantages for their anticipated victory, though Venezuela boasts a powerful offense led by Ronald Acuña Jr.
     
    You can watch a preview of the final matchup between Venezuela and the USA in this video:
    1m
    CBS Sports
    YouTube · Mar 16, 2026
    Why the USA is favored:
    • Star Power: The U.S. features top MLB talent like Aaron Judge, Bryce Harper, Paul Skenes, and Bobby Witt Jr. 
    • Pitching Depth: Their rotation and bullpen, including Mason Miller and Tarik Skubal, are considered superior to Venezuela's. 
    • Consistency: The team has shown tactical strength and the ability to handle pressure. 
    Venezuela's Strengths:
    • Offensive Firepower:
      A lineup with multiple All-Stars, including Ronald Acuña Jr. and Salvador Perez. 
    • Home Crowd Advantage:
      The final is expected to be played in Miami, a favorable location for Venezuelan fans. 
    Expert Predictions: 
    • Most predictions favor the USA, with many expecting them to win in a close, high-scoring game.
    • Common score predictions include USA 8-6, USA 5-2, and USA 7-6.
    Current Odds: 
    • The U.S. is a significant money-line favorite to win the championship.

      Who is Nolan McLean?
      An AI Overview is not available for this searchCan't generate an AI overview right now. Try again later.
      AI Overview
      Nolan McLean is a rising young professional baseball pitcher for the New York Mets, known for his dynamic pitching arsenal, especially his elite-level sweeper, and recently started for Team USA in the 2026 World Baseball Classic final. Drafted out of Oklahoma State in 2023, he made his MLB debut in August 2025 and quickly became a key part of the Mets' rotation, noted for his impressive performance in the majors and strong showings in the minors.
       
      Key Details: 
      • Team: New York Mets
      • Position: Pitcher (formerly also a two-way player)
      • MLB Debut: August 16, 2025, for the Mets
      • College: Oklahoma State University
      • Drafted: 3rd round, 2023 MLB Draft by the New York Mets
      • Notable Pitch: An exceptional sweeper (slider) with significant horizontal break
      Career Highlights:
      • Impressive 2025 Season:
        After a dominant start in Triple-A, he was called up and quickly became a reliable starter for the Mets, finishing his rookie year with a strong ERA and high strikeout numbers. 
      • World Baseball Classic (2026):
        Selected to represent Team USA, he started the championship game, showcasing his stuff on a global stage. 
      • Two-Way Origins:
        Drafted as a pitcher/outfielder, he transitioned fully to pitching in the Mets organization.
